name: Math-VR
intro: Math-VR 是大规模中英双语数学视觉推理语料与 benchmark。作者从约 90 万道含图解题中，经 Qwen2.5-VL-72B 筛图、GPT-4.1 转写和质检，得到 89,075 道独立问题、178,150 条双语样本；其中 2,500 道留出题展开为 5,000 条双语 benchmark 样本，并以答案正确性 AC 与过程部分得分 PS 评测。
build_method: 公开题目收集, VLM图像筛选, GPT辅助标准化与质检, 专家人工复核
metric: AC（答案正确性）, PS（过程部分得分）
task_type: 开放式数学问答, 视觉推理
eval_feature: 视觉推理, 双语评测, 过程评分
build_method_en: Public-problem collection, VLM image filtering, GPT-assisted standardization and quality checks, expert manual review
eval_feature_en: Visual reasoning, bilingual evaluation, process scoring
intro_en: Math-VR is a large-scale bilingual Chinese–English corpus and benchmark for mathematical visual reasoning. Starting from about 900K problems with illustrated solutions, Qwen2.5-VL-72B filters images and GPT-4.1 transcribes, standardizes, and verifies records, yielding 89,075 unique questions and 178,150 bilingual samples. The 2,500 held-out questions expand to 5,000 bilingual benchmark items scored with Answer Correctness (AC) and Process Score (PS).

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2510.11718 and the official HKU-MMLab/Math-VR-CodePlot-CoT release. The diagram covers the benchmark construction rather than confusing it with the separate CodePlot-CoT model method: roughly 900K source problems, Qwen2.5-VL-72B figure filtering, GPT-4.1 transcription, Markdown standardization, quality checking and bilingual translation, 89,075 unique questions split into 86,575 train and 2,500 test questions, and 178,150 bilingual samples. The benchmark path excludes proofs and most multiple choice, manually reviews a random 3,000-question pool with 15 senior STEM students, releases 2,500 unique / 5,000 bilingual test items, builds human-verified scoring points and difficulty weights, and reports AC and PS with human-correlation validation.
